scenario: With a count-in, REC counts a bar of clicks before recording
name: companion: a 1-bar song, COUNT-IN 1 bar; REC (stopped): four clicks (the count on screen), then the song; C4 played on its first beat is recorded there and comes round a bar later
note: The click is Off: the sounds before 4167 are the count-in's. The count-in's timing (the song on the fifth beat) is checked exactly in the seq unit test. Since D-051 (R-148) REC alone, while stopped, starts the count-in; it acts as REC is let go (1480).
